data.one_liner: A collection of small Dart utilities for data streams and I/O.
data.what_it_does: Provides interoperability with Java DataInputStream/DataOutputStream, byte buffer utilities, and stream helpers. Includes null‑safe updates and browser‑friendly I/O utilities.
use_when: You need to read/write binary data with custom endianness or floating point support.
You want lightweight stream helpers without pulling in a full framework.
You need browser‑compatible I/O utilities for web projects.
avoid_when: You are building a large application that already has a comprehensive I/O or stream library.
You require advanced networking or file system APIs beyond basic byte streams.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including web, mobile, and desktop.
Null‑safe and updated for modern Dart.
Provides both synchronous and asynchronous stream utilities.
weaknesses: Limited to low‑level I/O; no high‑level networking or file APIs.
Not actively maintained beyond 0.7.0 (last changelog entry).
Documentation is minimal and may require reading source for details.
